title: Object Art Gallery
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Art Object Gallery is located in the heart of Japantown in San Jose and has been showing artists around the bay for over fifteen years. We are now accepting submissions for an upcoming Ceramic/Enamel show. Other three dimensional mediums are welcome to apply. Please include with your submission and image with a clearly labeled title, date, medium, and price.
